qa_pairs.question: What is the torque specification for the transmission case rear/front sections?
What screw size is used for the cover with guide tube/transmission case?
What is the torque value for M8x22 screws on the cover with guide tube/transmission case?
What torque should be applied to M8x30 screws?
What is the torque specification for M6 screws?
What torque value is specified for the bearing cap/sealing flange?
What is the highest torque specification shown on this page?
qa_pairs.answer: 49 Nm for the reverse gear shaft on intermediate housing

qa_pairs.question: Which component has a torque specification of 25 Nm?
qa_pairs.answer: The retaining plate for reverse gear shaft on intermediate housing and M8x30 screws

qa_pairs.question: What section of the manual is this page from?
qa_pairs.answer: Section 23-3 Manual transmission, specifically 23 11 Case and Covers

qa_pairs.question: Do all the components listed apply to all vehicle types?
qa_pairs.answer: Yes, all components listed show 'All' in the Type column
